price_history.ohlc_sanitization: nonpositive or nonfinite open/high/low exported as null; inconsistent Korean-stock OHLC fields also exported as null; original source and model close unchanged

indicators.rule_note: v2 搜索后使用原生产 box；27个预登记稀疏窗口，非181窗完整扫描。box 不含振荡周期门槛。

top.scale_clusters_note: 复用现有分尺度聚类；share 是合格拟合数量占比，不是顶部概率；区间为20–80%分位。

research.sample_scope: current plus two registered earlier trading-day endpoints; no outcome scoring
research.cycles_1_5_rule: production box AND ahead>0 AND full_cycles>=1.5; same fit pool, not future-only refit

filter_diagnostics.note: 单项失败可重叠；累计数按B、m、omega、ahead顺序，不表示各指标独立。
